data.desc: JFrog Ltd. (Nasdaq: FROG), the creators of the software supply chain system of record, are on a mission to create a world of trusted software delivery without friction from development to production, whether software is written by developers or by AI. Driven by a 'Liquid Software' vision, the JFrog Platform is built to help organizations manage, secure, and govern binaries, models, agents, and AI-generated assets, so teams can distribute trusted software with speed, scale and control. The universal JFrog Platform is available as a managed SaaS service across all major cloud providers, as well as via self-managed and hybrid deployments. Millions of users and thousands of organizations worldwide, including a majority of the Fortune 100, depend on JFrog as a single source of truth to securely adopt AI and accelerate business transformation. Learn more at https://jfrog.com or follow us on X @JFrog.
